title: AI & ML Trends 2026: The Future is Now
logline: Explore the cutting-edge AI and Machine Learning trends shaping 2026, from generative models to healthcare innovations.

characters.name: Dr. Anya Sharma
characters.one_line_description: A charismatic and knowledgeable expert guiding viewers through the latest AI trends.

scenes.title: Welcome to 2026: AI's Leap Forward
scenes.summary: Dr. Anya Sharma introduces the video, setting the stage for the major AI and Machine Learning trends impacting 2026.
scenes.setting: Modern, sleek studio with dynamic, futuristic graphics.

scenes.title: Generative AI: Creativity Unleashed
scenes.summary: Dr. Sharma explains the rapid advancements and impact of generative AI across various domains, showcasing examples of AI-created content.
scenes.setting: Studio with vibrant overlays displaying AI-generated art, text, and video snippets.

scenes.title: Agentic Workflows: AI That Thinks
scenes.summary: Focuses on agentic AI workflows, where AI systems autonomously perform complex, multi-step tasks, improving efficiency and problem-solving.
scenes.setting: Studio with animated diagrams illustrating sequential AI task execution and automation.

scenes.title: Multimodal Models: Bridging Senses
scenes.summary: Discusses multimodal AI models that understand and generate content across different data types simultaneously (text, image, audio, video).
scenes.setting: Studio with visual examples of seamless multimodal AI interactions and outputs.

scenes.title: AI in Healthcare: A New Era
scenes.summary: Highlights the transformative role of AI in healthcare, covering breakthroughs in drug discovery, personalized medicine, and advanced diagnostics.
scenes.setting: Studio with medical-themed graphics, data visualizations, and conceptual hospital settings.

scenes.title: The Future is Now: Embracing AI
scenes.summary: Dr. Sharma provides a concise recap of the discussed trends and offers a concluding thought on the transformative power of AI in 2026 and beyond.
scenes.setting: Studio, returning to the initial futuristic and optimistic setting.

source_idea: A short educational video about the top AI and Machine Learning trends in 2026, covering generative AI, agentic workflows, multimodal models, and AI in healthcare
